scope: Captured factory browser frontend, all retrievable static dependencies, root and Pages project paths, original main/gmouse/g7max interfaces, and read-only A7 V3 Ultra+ verification.

checks.originalTitle: M HUB 迈从科技 官方驱动

browserNetwork.coverage: Opt-in local QA: fetch/XHR, resource timing and CSP; original services remain allowed. QA tools are absent from the published site.

limitations: Fourteen active dependencies remain HTTP 404 at the manufacturer and two firmware responses are proven HTTP 200 with zero bytes. URLs and evidence are recorded in mirror-independence.json; no usable files were fabricated and no original-CDN retry is used.
Login, cloud synchronization, community, notifications, user uploads, storefront and native desktop downloads retain manufacturer services. Authenticated cloud flows were not exercised.
Current physical testing covers read-only A7 V3 Ultra+ only. Other models and MagDock were not physically retested in this round. No firmware flashing, key, macro or DPI writes were performed.
This release loads resources on demand and does not provide whole-site offline caching. Publication and live-page verification are recorded separately in mirror-deployment.json.
